_meta.purpose: Single authority for AT/TC id allocation. See .dev-flow/AT-TC-REGISTRY-SPEC.md; allocation rule in its section 4.
_meta.grammar: id ::= (AT|TC) '-' stem [suffix]; stem ::= digit+ ['.' digit+]; suffix ::= [a-z]+
_meta.governed: A token whose body starts with a digit. Letter-initial bodies (AT-B64-04, AT-CRC-DSN-010, the AT-NNN placeholder) are batch-scoped / named-subspace ids, outside this authority by spec 2.3.
